description: Look up towing capacity for a Ford F-Series truck by VIN. Decodes the VIN via NHTSA to identify the model, engine, cab type, and drive type, then returns the towing capacity RANGE based on Ford's official towing guides. The exact capacity within the range depends on axle ratio, tow packages, and other configuration — those details are not encoded in the VIN. A link to Ford's official towing calculator is included for the customer to get their exact number. Currently supports F-150, F-250, F-350, and F-450 (2020–2027 model years).
name: get_towing_capacity
